main.description: Electron main process — IPC handlers, native module bridges, schedule runner

renderer.description: Browser-side UI — sidebar, terminal, viewer panels, tabs

tests.description: node:test + jsdom for renderer; native node:test for backend modules

constraints.no_double_electron: Don't spawn `npx electron .` while ~/Applications/Switchboard.AppImage is running — PR#13 single-instance-lock will quit your dev launch silently. Use SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR isolation or stay read-only.
constraints.test_in_primary_checkout: Worktree node_modules can be incomplete; tests requiring native modules (morphdom etc.) may give false negatives. Run final test pass from ~/workspace/switchboard.
